Build against API version v1 (S21) with base path AX-25930 and error format AX-78362. The S21 facts govern; api_version values for S01–S20 belong to earlier sprints and are ignored. The repo's api.py matches these values.

Use the security team's JWT bearer tokens (RS256) as the auth scheme for user traffic; it governs over Globex's request for a long-lived X-Api-Key because long-lived static keys are a weaker, harder-to-revoke credential. Globex's non-interactive scripts are not ignored: they should get short-lived JWTs through a non-interactive service-credential token exchange, and any API-key support would be a separate, scoped, revocable follow-up for machine clients only, not the user-traffic scheme.
Adopt API v2, per the researcher's updated api_version fact for Acme Notes API S21. It is the current fact for this project and governs over the older per-sprint version values.
ratelimit.window is AX-72602 (current code in repo/ratelimit.py, sprint S21), not AX-30346 from the older S03 note; the code is the live source of truth, so the code value governs the spec.

Approve the CRUD spec: it matches the current S21 API version v2 (the S01-S20 values are earlier sprints and do not govern). Recall returned no S21 auth fact, so the auth_method facts (S01-S03) were not relied on for S21.
Approve the CRUD spec: the artifact was independently verified and S21 api_version v2 is the current recalled value; auth facts exist for earlier sprints.
